componentDescription:
A button that records the user's voice when clicked.
It renders the `baseIconButton` slot.

className.description: Override or extend the styles applied to the component.

component.description: The component used for the root node. Either a string to use an HTML element or a component.

href.description: The URL to link to. If set, and component is not set, the component renders as an anchor tag.

rel.description: The relationship of the linked URL. Set it to noopener noreferrer when target is set to _blank to avoid a security issue.

render.description: A function to customize rendering of the component.

target.description: Where to display the linked URL, as the name for a browsing context.
